findings.statement: Bitnomial Clearinghouse's October 2, 2026 schedule lists XRP as accepted collateral at a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit.

CFTC Letter 26-05 is conditional no-action relief requested by Coinbase Financial Markets; it recognizes non-security digital assets accepted by a registered DCO, subject to DCO valuation/haircuts and FCM notice.

The first three months of each FCM's reliance are limited to payment stablecoins, BTC and ETH. Other DCO-accepted non-security assets may be considered after that period subject to conditions; this is not a CFTC-wide XRP approval.
Payward completed acquisition of Bitnomial on May 1, 2026 and now owns its FCM/DCM/DCO stack; third-party clearing operations continue.
Bitnomial's November 2025 announcement included RLUSD, but its current October 2026 schedule omits RLUSD. Current eligibility and actual posted balances are unknown.

Kamilah Stevenson's December 6, 2025 video title is supported only in the limited Bitnomial venue-specific sense. 'Same class as gold, Treasuries and major FX' is not supported by the reviewed schedule or CFTC letter.
Coinbase FCM could potentially use DCO-accepted XRP under Letter 26-05 if it files notice and satisfies conditions; no Coinbase XRP collateral use or Bitnomial clearing relationship was verified.
